extraction_text: Abhimanyu sent Kshatriya warriors to Yama's abode with his deadly arrows in battle.

Abhimanyu, radiant, scatters the armies like wind scattering cotton piles.
Duryodhana's army is scattered by Abhimanyu, finding no protector, like an elephant stuck in mud.
Abhimanyu stands after scattering the army, like a smokeless flame.
All of Duryodhana's warriors cannot withstand Abhimanyu, like moths unable to resist flame.
Abhimanyu strikes all enemies of the Pandavas, like Indra with his thunderbolt.

The Kuru army is tormented by Abhimanyu, like a drunken woman wandering about.
After scattering the army, Duryodhana's great warriors tremble, while friends rejoice, like Indra defeating Maya.
